fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/ciworkflow (go test -trimpath ./internal/ciworkflow/...) parse .github/workflows/ci.yml and assert: a `changes` job with an output code, computing it from git diff --name-only against the merge base on pull_request and setting it true on workflow_dispatch; lint, scripts, api, rest and budgets each needing changes with if on code == 'true'; a `model` job needing changes with if on code == 'false' that runs make self-check; check needing changes, model and the five Go jobs, if: always(), failing unless changes succeeded and every other result is success or skipped, and failing when none of model and the five Go jobs succeeded (an all-skipped run fails check); the existing triggers, concurrency, matrices and cache checks still pass. make check is unchanged. The change set's own PR touches Go code so runs everything; the next model-only PR's CI completes in a few minutes with check green, read from gh run view.
fields.statement: On a pull request whose changed paths all lie under .rhiza/, CI runs only a `model` job (setup-go, make self-check) and skips lint, scripts, api, rest and budgets, decided by a first `changes` job using plain git diff against the merge base (code=true when any path is outside .rhiza/, always true on workflow_dispatch); any other PR and every dispatched run on main runs everything as today, and the aggregate `check` job, needing changes, model and the five Go jobs with if: always(), fails unless changes succeeded and passes only when every other job is success or skipped with at least one of them succeeded.

fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/api (go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'ChecksVerdict|ShipRerunFailed|WatchdogCIRerun') feed checksVerdict a rollup of SKIPPED lint, scripts, api, rest and budgets plus SUCCESS changes, model and check and get settled and green with no failed names; run shipRerunFailed on such a head and assert it issues no gh run rerun; and, in a TestWatchdogCIRerun case in internal/api/daemon_watchdog_test.go, feed watchdogCIRerun a PR whose head has the Go jobs SKIPPED and changes, model and check SUCCESS and assert it issues no gh run rerun and that rerunSpent does not count the rerun spent.
fields.statement: ship check reads a model-only PR's CI as settled and green: a check rollup whose skipped jobs conclude SKIPPED and whose `check` and `model` jobs conclude SUCCESS is settled and green, and the CI rerun reruns nothing for SKIPPED jobs.
